name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a webpage. mode='read' (default): visible text content, good for reading an article or page the user linked. mode='scrape': extract structured data -- either one field via 'selector' (+ optional 'attribute'), or multiple fields at once via 'selectors' (a field_name->CSS selector map), optionally one-record-per-item via 'repeat_selector' -- use this when the user wants specific DATA out of a page (a list of items, every matching link, table cell values, product cards), not a text summary. mode='crawl': same 'selectors'/'repeat_selector' extraction repeated across multiple pages by following a 'next_page_selector' link, up to 'max_pages' -- use for pagination (e.g. collect every listing across several results pages). DNS-resolved SSRF protection blocks private/loopback/link-local IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Only sees the initial HTML response -- for JS-rendered content, use @browser instead. Static HTML only, no JavaScript execution.

url.description: The full URL to fetch, including https://. For mode='crawl' this is the starting page.

mode.description: 'read' (default): flattened visible text. 'scrape': structured extraction from ONE page via 'selector' or 'selectors'. 'crawl': structured extraction across MULTIPLE pages via 'selectors' + 'next_page_selector'.

selector.description: Single-field CSS selector for mode='scrape', e.g. 'div.product-title', 'a[href]', 'table tr td', '.price'. Use this OR 'selectors', not both.

attribute.description: Optional, only used together with 'selector' (not 'selectors'): extract this HTML attribute (e.g. 'href', 'src') from each matched element instead of its text content.

limit.description: Optional, only used together with 'selector' (not 'selectors'): max number of matched elements to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

selectors.description: Multi-field CSS selector map for mode='scrape' or mode='crawl', e.g. {"title": "h1", "price": ".price"}. Each field's matches are extracted as text. Use this OR 'selector', not both. Required for mode='crawl'.

repeat_selector.description: Optional, used with 'selectors': treats each match of this CSS selector as one row/record — every selector in 'selectors' is then looked up WITHIN each row instead of once across the whole page. Use for lists of cards/listings/items where you want one structured record per item (e.g. {"rows": [{"title":..., "price":...}, ...]}) instead of separate flat lists you'd have to zip back together yourself.

next_page_selector.description: Required for mode='crawl'. CSS selector for the 'next page' link — its href is followed to get each subsequent page.

max_pages.description: For mode='crawl' only. Hard cap on pages fetched, default 5, maximum 15 — this server runs on a tight memory budget, crawling isn't unbounded.
